hook.en: Most Indians still live in villages, and a large part of them depend on farming. If the villages stay poor, India stays poor. So what does it take to develop a village?
hook.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಭಾರತೀಯರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅವರಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುಪಾಲು ಕೃಷಿಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳು ಬಡವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಭಾರತವೂ ಬಡವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಲು ಏನು ಬೇಕು?

objectives.en: Explain why it needs attention after 1991

narration.en: Most Indians still live in villages, and a large part of them depend on farming. If the villages stay poor, India stays poor. So what does it take to develop a village?
narration.kn: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಭಾರತೀಯರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಅವರಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುಪಾಲು ಕೃಷಿಯನ್ನು ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳು ಬಡವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಭಾರತವೂ ಬಡವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸಲು ಏನು ಬೇಕು?

body.en: Rural development is action for the development of areas that are lagging behind in the overall development of the village economy. Its key areas are: development of human resources (literacy, especially female literacy, education, skills, health and sanitation); land reforms; development of the productive resources of each locality; infrastructure (electricity, irrigation, credit, marketing, transport, agricultural research and extension, information); and special measures to reduce poverty and improve the living conditions of weaker sections.
body.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಮವೇ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಭೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್, ನೀರಾವರಿ, ಸಾಲ, ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ, ರಸ್ತೆಗಳಂತಹ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡತನ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ.

points.en: Human resources: literacy, skills, health, sanitation
Infrastructure: power, irrigation, credit, markets, roads

narration.en: Rural development means acting to develop the villages that lag behind. It covers people's education and health, land reforms, local productive resources, infrastructure like power, irrigation, credit, markets and roads, and special steps against poverty.
narration.kn: ಹಿಂದುಳಿದ ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಮವೇ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮತ್ತು ಆರೋಗ್ಯ, ಭೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ, ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಉತ್ಪಾದಕ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲಗಳು, ವಿದ್ಯುತ್, ನೀರಾವರಿ, ಸಾಲ, ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ, ರಸ್ತೆಗಳಂತಹ ಮೂಲಸೌಕರ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡತನ ನಿವಾರಣೆ ಸೇರಿವೆ.

title.en: The five pillars of rural development

narration.en: The teacher builds a mind map with rural development at the centre and its key areas around it.

say.en: In the centre, rural development: helping the villages that lag behind.
First, people: literacy, skills and health. Second, land reforms. Third, infrastructure.
Fourth, using each locality's own productive resources. Fifth, special steps to remove poverty and create jobs.
Gandhi said the real progress of India lies mainly in developing its villages.

prompt.en: Sort each action into the key area of rural development it belongs to.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಯ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

text.en: Giving ownership of land to the tiller
Special measures for the weaker sections

explanation.en: Rural development covers people (education, health, skills), land reforms, infrastructure and special steps for the poor, because most Indians still depend on the village economy.

body.en: Agriculture's share in GDP has fallen, but a large part of the workforce still depends on it. After 1991, public investment in agriculture declined, and weak infrastructure, few jobs outside farming and rising costs slowed agricultural growth. Rural development is therefore central to India's overall development.
body.kn: ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಆದಾಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷಿಯ ಪಾಲು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗಿದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಜನರು ಇನ್ನೂ ಅದನ್ನೇ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. 1991 ರ ನಂತರ ಕೃಷಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಹೂಡಿಕೆ ಕುಸಿದು ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಯಿತು; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಅಭಿವೃದ್ಧಿಗೆ ವಿಶೇಷ ಗಮನ ಬೇಕು.

points.en: Many people, falling share of agricultural income
Public investment in agriculture declined after 1991
Need for non-farm jobs and better infrastructure

narration.en: Farming's share in national income has fallen, but many people still depend on it. After 1991, public investment in agriculture declined and growth slowed, so rural development needs special attention.

problem.en: Hosahalli village has low female literacy, no all-weather road, farmers who borrow from a moneylender, and no work for many people after the kharif harvest. Match each problem to an area of rural development.

steps.en: Low female literacy: development of human resources.
Borrowing from a moneylender: infrastructure (institutional credit).
No work after kharif: productive employment through diversification and poverty alleviation measures.

answer.en: Human resources; infrastructure (roads, credit); productive employment

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Hosahalli village has low female literacy, no all-weather road, farmers who borrow from a moneylender, and no work for many people after the kharif harvest. Match each problem to an area of rural development.
